name: Botty
author: meviusisback
description: Desktop AI Agent assistant widget powered by Hermes profile Botty with screen awareness, multimodal media context, persistent memory, and native Omarchy desktop actions.

barWidget.description: Interactive AI desktop assistant in your Omarchy top bar. Read screen context, attach media, execute actions, switch models, and learn continuously.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How frequently the widget polls for status updates.

schema.label: Bar display mode
schema.description: Visual representation in the status bar: Icon (glyph and dot), Status (last request snippet, or APPROVE while a card waits), or Compact (status word).

schema.label: Show status indicators in bar
schema.description: Show the status colour and the activity dot on the bar icon.
